user.title: Connect to your gateway
user.description: Enter the address and token shown in the gateway's manager, under Home connection. This Home Assistant dials out to the gateway; no port is opened at home.

data_description.address: Your own gateway subdomain and port, for example alice.gw.example.com:443
data_description.token: Created in the gateway's manager, under Home connection. It is shown once there.
data_description.use_tls: Turn off only on a trusted network: without TLS the token travels in clear.
data_description.local_url: Where calls from the gateway are replayed. The default fits a standard installation.
data_description.forward_client_ip: Lets Home Assistant see the real caller (IP bans, trusted networks). Needs use_x_forwarded_for and 127.0.0.1 in trusted_proxies in the http configuration.

reauth_confirm.title: The gateway no longer accepts the token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {host} was replaced or revoked. Create a new one in the gateway's manager, under Home connection, and enter it here.

data_description.address: Your own gateway subdomain and port, for example alice.gw.example.com:443
data_description.token: Created in the gateway's manager, under Home connection.
data_description.use_tls: Turn off only on a trusted network: without TLS the token travels in clear.
data_description.local_url: Where calls from the gateway are replayed.
data_description.forward_client_ip: Needs use_x_forwarded_for and 127.0.0.1 in trusted_proxies in the http configuration.

error.cannot_connect: No gateway answered at that address. Check the address and port, and whether TLS should be on.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway does not accept this token. Copy it again from the manager, or create a new one.
error.unsupported_gateway: Something answers at that address, but it is not a gateway this version can talk to. Update the gateway.
error.invalid_url: Must start with http:// or https://
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This gateway account is already connected.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.
abort.reauth_successful: The new token works. The connection is being restored.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. The connection is being restored.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different gateway account. Use a token of the account this Home Assistant is connected to, or remove the integration and add it again.
